annotation.bound_parties_text: The notice is addressed to provincial transport, industry and information technology, SASAC and market supervision authorities, relevant central enterprises, and units of the Ministry of Transport, who are asked to implement the action plan.

annotation.robot_provision_quote: 智能航运是以船舶自主化为重点，以基础设施数字化为支撑，以运行控制协同化为保障的水路运输系统。
